mechanism: Canonical forbidden partial assignments / width<=4 clauses are the state content. Different derivation histories are collapsed. Exact semantic dominance by subsumption keeps only a minimal active forbidden-pattern basis. Fixed-width resolution runs on that basis; the immutable exact witness is consulted only after fixed point.
polynomial_statement: For n variables at frozen width k=4, the universe of canonical non-tautological clause/pattern states is N_4(n)=SUM_{i=0..4} binom(n,i)2^i=O(n^4). This does not by itself prove a polynomial transition/runtime bound adequate for arbitrary CNF, nor universality of fixed width 4.
scientific_interpretation: The R10 width-5 Davis-Putnam obstacle was a path/compiler obstacle on these two worlds: R12B derived the exact final width-4 interfaces without creating width>4 candidate states. The result is retrospective/scoped to the two previously exposed interfaces and therefore requires unseen generalization before any stronger claim.
